speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellowing of the eyes and skin; to determine the cause, I need to know your exact age in hours or days and if your baby is breastfed or formula-fed. Also, have you noticed any fever, poor feeding, or dark urine?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Prolonged Physiological Jaundice)

The increasing bilirubin is common in exclusively breastfed 2-week-olds, but we must rule out hemolysis. REQUEST TEST: Total Serum Bilirubin, Direct Bilirubin, and Blood Type.
